results.title: Where everyone is in the text; connection notices
results.checks: Signed in, the host starts a session and a guest joins. The guest reads further down John 3: on the host's screen a bar in the guest's colour runs beside the verses on the guest's screen, with the guest's initials at its top. When the host leaves the page, the guest is told 'The host disconnected'
results.note: the guest's bar ran beside John 3:16 with "FG" at its top; the guest was told the host disconnected

results.title: Show everyone, the roster, chat, the record
results.checks: Host starts a session (a record is kept in the Library; its path on hover); a guest joins; the guest selects 3:16 and the host's roster says so; the host shows everyone 3:9 and the guest sees the ribbon; a chat line from the guest reaches the host
results.note: record kept; roster shows the guest at verse 16; the guest saw verse 9 shown; chat reached the host (code S4DDPK)

results.title: Listening follows the verse; the ring when paused
results.checks: Listening to John 3, a jump near the end of the bar brings the verse being read into view on its own; on an iPhone 13, pausing part-way puts a progress ring round the play button, and the scrubber shows again on Play
results.note: a jump to 85% brought verse 31 into view; on a phone the ring showed when paused and the scrubber on Play

results.title: Someone's highlight off screen
results.checks: In a live session, with a guest at the top of John 3, the host shows everyone verse 30: the guest sees a pill 'Highlighted verse 30' at the bottom edge with the host's face, which folds after a few seconds into a corner indicator ('Highlight below, verse 30. Show it'); clicking it brings verse 30 into view and the cue goes
results.note: the guest saw 'Highlighted verse 30' with the host's face, then 'Highlight below, verse 30. Show it', which brought verse 30 into view
